name: l2cap_send_handler

ownership.argument: Bluelet owner-only handler; the cid that submit_cid carries is not the same field the wrapper stores (request+4 vs the cid used inside), so a module must go through the wrapper rather than call this directly.

provenance.source: Submitted by bt_l2cap_submit_cid 0xC805BE8, which stores the cid into request+4 first. Resolves the channel base from *(owner) and, for cids <= 0x3F, issues owner command 0x26 with the channel handle through 0xC7EAD7C before re-fragmenting the buffer in place (it rewrites the length words at request+2 and the payload tail).

notes: Bluelet owner-only handler; the cid that submit_cid carries is not the same field the wrapper stores (request+4 vs the cid used inside), so a module must go through the wrapper rather than call this directly.
